 Joe Rindl, Charlotte Coates, Emma Smith & Gary Rose
 Most recent Most popular Post published at 15:26 GMT 15:26 GMT 
 Aston Villa 0-0 Sunderland 
 Here come Sunderland as Noah Sadiki slips it right to Wilson Isidor but Villa have enough men in the way and the effort is charged down. 
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Chelsea 1-0 Leeds published at 15:25 GMT 15:25 GMT 
 Emmanuel Emegha (25 mins) 
 First Premier League start = first Chelsea goal for Emmanuel Emegha! 
 It is a really good strike by the forward as Morgan Rogers feeds the ball through to him and Emegha drives in at James Trafford's near post.
 453 444 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:24 GMT 15:24 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Leeds 
 Dominic Calvert-Lewin gets in-between Levi Colwill and Wesley Fofana to meet a cross, but his header is straight at Emi Martinez. 
 103 42 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 PENALTY APPEAL published at 15:23 GMT 15:23 GMT 
 Coventry 1-1 Crystal Palace 
 Frustration for Coventry fans as they think their side should have a penalty.
 Taiwo Awoniyi is down on the floor as Jack Rudoni's free-kick goes into the box, but the whistle goes for a foul by Awoniyi on Axel Disasi.
 89 57 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:22 GMT 15:22 GMT 
 Aston Villa 0-0 Sunderland 
 Sunderland fail to clear the Villa free-kick at the first time of asking as Luke O'Nien switches off but a team-mate comes to his rescue to hammer it away. 
 72 30 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 15:22 GMT 15:22 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Leeds 
 Chelsea are going to have to make a change here. Moises Caicedo is down on the pitch for the second time in this game and cannot continue. He is replaced by Jordan Henderson.
 84 98 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Evanilson is on fire' published at 15:21 GMT 15:21 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Nottingham Forest 
 Steph Houghton 
Former England defender on Final Score 
 Fantastic finish, Evanilson's in red hot form. Forest have been wary of him, it's a great touch from James Hill and he fires it into the rough of the net. He's on fire. 
 119 50 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:21 GMT 15:21 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Nottingham Forest 
 Evanilson scored six goals in his first 44 Premier League matches.
 He now has six in his last six league games.
 83 27 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GREAT SAVE! published at 15:19 GMT 15:19 GMT 
 Aston Villa 0-0 Sunderland 
 Johan Manzambi drives up the pitch and decides to have a go instead of finding Nicolas Jackson. 
 Decent enough save from Robin Roefs. 
 147 29 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HITS THE WOODWORK published at 15:19 GMT 15:19 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Leeds 
 Leeds go so close to taking the lead as Dominic Calvert-Lewin slams an effort against the woodwork, with Emi Martinez beaten.
 251 72 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'The future is bright for Spurs' published at 15:19 GMT 15:19 GMT 
 Tottenham 1-0 Ipswich 
 Nedum Onuoha 
Former Man City defender on Final Score 
 The desire Luca Williams-Barnett shows to get in and around the box, it's a really well timed run and the physicality to get in there. A huge moment for him. 
 I think he's only just turned 18. For Spurs the future is bright. 
 489 87 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Bournemouth 1-0 Nottingham Forest published at 15:18 GMT 15:18 GMT 
 Evanilson (18 mins) 
 Image source, Getty Images Six in a row!
 Evanilson maintains his red-hot form from before the international break. It's a lovely cushioned header from new England call up James Hill, into space on the edge of the box, and the Brazilian striker slams his finish into the roof of the net.
 Bournemouth are on course for nine successive wins in all competitions. Evanilson has scored now in six league games in a row.
 414 196 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:18 GMT 15:18 GMT 
 Aston Villa 0-0 Sunderland 
 Sunderland have 11 men parked behind the ball and they're more than happy for Villa to knock it around in front of them. 
 The Black Cats might take a decent bit of breaking down this afternoon. 
 66 41 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:16 GMT 15:16 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Leeds 
 Chelsea are on the attack again as Cole Palmer works the ball out wide to Estêvão, who gets into the box but then whips a shot straight into James Trafford's hands.
 115 60 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'It's certainly acrobatic' published at 15:15 GMT 15:15 GMT 
 Coventry 1-1 Crystal Palace 
 Nedum Onuoha 
Former Man City defender on Final Score 
 It'll go down as an assist but Jorgen Strand Larsen did not fully intend it. It's certainly acrobatic. A goal is a goal though. 
 As far as momentum goes I think Crystal Palace will be more than happy with that. 
 157 49 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Tottenham 1-0 Ipswich published at 15:15 GMT 15:15 GMT 
 Luca Williams-Barnett (15 mins) 
 The eighteen-year-old has put Tottenham ahead!
 Pedro Porro whips a cross towards the back post and teenager Luca Williams-Barnett gets ahead of a napping Abdoul Ouattara and pokes the ball into the bottom corner on the slide.
 1974 428 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Jackson looking sharp published at 15:14 GMT 15:14 GMT 
 Aston Villa 0-0 Sunderland 
 Phil McNulty 
BBC Sport chief football writer at Villa Park 
 Nicolas Jackson has been a real stand-out for Aston Villa this season and the striker has already posed a threat to the Sunderland defence here. 
 Couple of sharp turns and pace creating openings. Sense more to come from him, although The Black Cats have also shown confidence going forward.
 129 21 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:14 GMT 15:14 GMT 
 Aston Villa 0-0 Sunderland 
 Better from the visitors as Thomas Meunier aims for Wilson Isidor in the box but they win a throw-in instead. 
 40 33 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Coventry 1-1 Crystal Palace published at 15:14 GMT 15:14 GMT 
 Yéremy Pino (13 mins) 
 Crystal Palace are level!
 Daichi Kamada sends the ball into the box, Jørgen Strand Larsen attempts either an awful shot or a brilliantly acrobatic assist to tee up Yéremy Pino to slam the ball into the roof of the net. 
 380 137 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Emegha is trying to get Chelsea going published at 15:13 GMT 15:13 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Leeds 
 Nizaar Kinsella 
BBC Sport football reporter at Stamford Bridge 
 It's a very scrappy game so far at Stamford Bridge with a lot of niggly fouls and not a lot of goal mouth action. 
 There was a half-hearted penalty shout when Emmanuel Emegha went down in the box. 
 It's Emegha who is trying to get the crowd going by throwing up his hands in the air.
